result.title: TokenMatte: Unlocking T2V Diffusion Priors for Pixel-Native Video Matting
result.summary: High-resolution video matting requires accurate recovery of continuous alpha values, including fine hair, soft boundaries, and motion blur, yet dense alpha supervision remains scarce. Pretrained text-to-video diffusion transformers (DiTs) offer rich spatio-temporal priors, whereas existing generative video matting approaches typically route alpha predictions through RGB-trained VAE latents, which can attenuate fine details and introduce additional decoding overhead. We present TokenMatte, which adapts a pretrained video DiT into a single-pass, auxiliary-free RGB-to-alpha predictor with a pixel-native output interface. At its core is a single shared linear readout that maps each spatio-temporal token directly to its corresponding ($t \times p \times p$) block of alpha pixels, predicting spatial details and temporal variations within the same local video block. Tiling these blocks produces the full-resolution alpha sequence without a convolutional decoder or learned upsampling. The predicted alpha is supervised directly in pixel space, while the ground-truth alpha never enters the VAE, eliminating target-side alpha encoding and output-side VAE decoding. Leveraging the pretrained video prior, TokenMatte is trained using only existing public matting datasets, without additional data curation or auxiliary inputs at inference. Compared with a matched latent-output baseline, our pixel-native interface improves matting accuracy while achieving a 1.51$\times$ inference speedup. TokenMatte establishes a new auxiliary-free state of the art on VideoMatte, YouTubeMatte, and V-HIM60.

AI.brief_summary: 将预训练视频 T2V DiT 改造为单次、无额外辅助输入的高分辨率视频抠像器，用共享线性读出把每个时空 token 直接映射为对应的 alpha 像素块，省去 VAE 解码与卷积上采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 原文指出经 RGB 训练的 VAE latent 会削弱细节，并改用 token 直出像素的读出方式，这可为 LVR 中「内部状态是否保留视觉细节」及如何从 latent 读出细粒度视觉内容提供可供核查的线索；但任务属视频抠像，迁移性需自行判断。
